summary: Standing rule extending DEC-0183: when cli-dispatch requeue refuses at the retry cap although the task has an OPEN PR (the failed verdict carries prNumber but no prUrl, so the AISDLC-847 follow-up path does not fire), dispatch re-enqueues with remove-verdict --from failed plus write-manifest carrying a resume note; applies to AISDLC-840, AISDLC-837 and every later case until the requeue fix lands

options.description: Dispatch copies the failed manifest, adds the resume note and prUrl, runs remove-verdict --from failed then write-manifest --json. Sanctioned, on the dispatch operational list.
Someone adds prUrl to failed/<id>.verdict.json by hand
Park until the requeue fix lands
